blocks.text: Asia’s Songbird Regine Velasquez left fans and fellow celebrities in awe on the first night of her “Finale” concert series, which featured her classic hits and a surprise reunion performance with her “Do Re Mi” co-stars Donna Cruz and Mikee Cojuangco. Velasquez opened the show on Saturday, Oct. 17, with “Narito Ako,” followed by a performance of “You Are My Song,” which brought the veteran singer-actress to tears. She continued the night with her songs including “You’ve Made Me Stronger,” “Kung Maibabalik Ko Lang,” “Pangarap Ko ang Ibigin Ka,” “Pangako,” “Kailangan Ko’y Ikaw,” before welcoming her husband, veteran singer-songwriter Ogie Alcasid, […]...
